cups_01.name: Ace of Cups
cups_01.shortReversed: Your cup may need filling before it can pour; consider what would quietly replenish you today.
cups_01.shortUpright: A fresh feeling may be rising; this card invites you to let it in and notice where it wants to flow.

cups_02.name: Two of Cups
cups_02.shortReversed: Something between you and another may feel out of balance; consider what each of you is really asking for.
cups_02.shortUpright: A moment to notice where care flows both ways, and what makes a connection feel equal and alive.

cups_03.name: Three of Cups
cups_03.shortReversed: Connection may feel thin or tiring right now; consider which gatherings nourish you and which only fill time.
cups_03.shortUpright: A moment to notice who shares your joys, and how you might share theirs in return.

cups_04.name: Four of Cups
cups_04.shortReversed: Interest may be returning after a quiet stretch; consider which invitation feels worth accepting now.
cups_04.shortUpright: You may be turned inward for a while; this card invites you to notice what is being offered while you reflect.

cups_05.name: Five of Cups
cups_05.shortReversed: The weight of a disappointment may be easing; consider what has remained with you and where you want to turn next.
cups_05.shortUpright: A loss may be filling your view; this card invites you to grieve honestly and, in time, notice what still stands.

cups_06.name: Six of Cups
cups_06.shortReversed: The past may be pulling harder than usual; consider which memories nourish you and which keep you from the present.
cups_06.shortUpright: A memory or a simple kindness may bring warmth today; this card invites you to notice what the past still gives you.

cups_07.name: Seven of Cups
cups_07.shortReversed: The fog of options may be lifting; consider which choice still feels real once the glow of imagining fades.
cups_07.shortUpright: Many possibilities may be shimmering at once; this card invites you to enjoy imagining, then look closely at each one.

cups_08.name: Eight of Cups
cups_08.shortReversed: You may be torn between staying and going; consider what you would need to know before choosing either one.
cups_08.shortUpright: Something may no longer fill you, even if it looks complete; this card invites you to notice where your heart is pulling next.

cups_09.name: Nine of Cups
cups_09.shortReversed: Something may look satisfying without feeling so; consider what would bring you contentment from the inside.
cups_09.shortUpright: A moment to savor what is already good, and to notice how much of it you helped bring about.

cups_10.name: Ten of Cups
cups_10.shortReversed: Harmony may feel strained or out of reach; consider what belonging would mean for you, beyond any ideal picture.
cups_10.shortUpright: A moment to notice where you already feel at home, and who helps you feel you belong.

cups_11.name: Page of Cups
cups_11.shortReversed: A tender feeling may be hiding or wobbling; consider how you could make it safe to express what you feel.
cups_11.shortUpright: A playful feeling or a small creative idea may surprise you; this card invites you to meet it with curiosity.

cups_12.name: Knight of Cups
cups_12.shortReversed: Feelings may be running ahead of reality; consider which promises and dreams you can actually carry through.
cups_12.shortUpright: A heartfelt idea or invitation may be moving toward you; this card invites you to follow what you care about with grace.

cups_13.name: Queen of Cups
cups_13.shortReversed: You may be absorbing more than you can hold; consider what care and boundaries would help you feel steady.
cups_13.shortUpright: This card invites you to listen deeply, to others and to yourself, with a calm and compassionate presence.

cups_14.name: King of Cups
cups_14.shortReversed: Feelings may be held too tightly or spilling unevenly; consider what would help you meet them with steadiness.
cups_14.shortUpright: This card invites you to stay steady in strong currents, guiding with both feeling and clear thought.

major_00.name: The Fool
major_00.shortReversed: A pause at the edge: is it caution, or a fear of looking foolish?
major_00.shortUpright: A step into something new, taken with more curiosity than certainty.

major_01.name: The Magician
major_01.shortReversed: Your tools are on the table, but your attention may be elsewhere. What would help you gather it?
major_01.shortUpright: You may already hold more of what you need than you think; this card asks what you want to make with it.

major_02.name: The High Priestess
major_02.shortReversed: Outside noise may be drowning out a quieter voice inside you; a little silence could help.
major_02.shortUpright: A quiet invitation to listen to what you already sense but have not yet put into words.

major_03.name: The Empress
major_03.shortReversed: Care may be flowing outward while your own well is running low. Where could some of it return to you?
major_03.shortUpright: Something is growing, in you or around you. This card invites you to tend it with patience and warmth.

major_04.name: The Emperor
major_04.shortReversed: Rules that once helped may now feel tight. What would a kinder, sturdier structure look like?
major_04.shortUpright: A time to build some structure around what matters, and to take calm ownership of your choices.

major_05.name: The Hierophant
major_05.shortReversed: An inherited rule may no longer fit. This card invites you to test it against what you truly value.
major_05.shortUpright: There may be wisdom in what others have walked before you. What tradition or teacher could help right now?

major_06.name: The Lovers
major_06.shortReversed: Part of you may want one thing and part another. This card invites you to listen to both before choosing.
major_06.shortUpright: A choice made from the heart and the head together, in line with what you truly value.

major_07.name: The Chariot
major_07.shortReversed: Energy may be pulling in several directions at once. Where could you gently take back the reins?
major_07.shortUpright: Momentum is possible when you hold your different drives together and point them in one direction.

major_08.name: Strength
major_08.shortReversed: Your inner steadiness may feel thin right now. Gentleness toward yourself could be a strong place to start.
major_08.shortUpright: Courage does not always roar. Sometimes it looks like patience, kindness and staying with something hard.

major_09.name: The Hermit
major_09.shortReversed: Solitude may have tipped into isolation, or into avoiding the quiet altogether. What balance feels right?
major_09.shortUpright: A little time apart could help you hear your own thoughts more clearly.

major_10.name: Wheel of Fortune
major_10.shortReversed: A familiar pattern may be coming round again. What could you do differently this time?
major_10.shortUpright: Things are turning. This card invites you to notice the cycle you are in and how you want to move with it.

major_11.name: Justice
major_11.shortReversed: Something may feel out of balance. This card invites you to look at it clearly, including your own part.
major_11.shortUpright: A moment to weigh things honestly and act in a way you would feel good explaining later.

major_12.name: The Hanged Man
major_12.shortReversed: Waiting may have turned into stalling. What would help you decide whether to stay still or move?
major_12.shortUpright: A pause, chosen or not, can offer a view you would never see while rushing ahead.

major_13.name: Death
major_13.shortReversed: Something may be ready to end while part of you holds on. What would help you loosen your grip?
major_13.shortUpright: A phase may be closing. This card invites you to notice what is ending and the space it leaves.

major_14.name: Temperance
major_14.shortReversed: Something may be tipping too far one way. This card invites you to notice and gently rebalance.
major_14.shortUpright: A slower, steadier blend of what you need could bring more ease than any extreme.

major_15.name: The Devil
major_15.shortReversed: A pattern that once had a firm hold may be loosening. What would help you step further away?
major_15.shortUpright: A habit or attachment may be holding you more tightly than you realize. Noticing it is the first step.

major_16.name: The Tower
major_16.shortReversed: Change may be arriving slowly rather than all at once. What could you rebuild more honestly?
major_16.shortUpright: Something built on shaky ground may be shifting. This card invites you to notice what was not holding.

major_17.name: The Star
major_17.shortReversed: Hope may feel far away right now. Small, steady things could help you find your way back to it.
major_17.shortUpright: After a hard stretch, a quieter hope may be returning. This card invites you to let it in.

major_18.name: The Moon
major_18.shortReversed: A fog may be starting to lift. What do you see more clearly now than you did before?
major_18.shortUpright: Not everything is clear yet, and that is all right. This card invites you to move slowly and trust your senses.

major_19.name: The Sun
major_19.shortReversed: The light is still there, even if clouds are passing. What helps you feel warm and clear?
major_19.shortUpright: A moment of warmth and clarity. This card invites you to enjoy what is bright and open in your life.

major_20.name: Judgement
major_20.shortReversed: An inner critic may be louder than usual. What would a fair, kind look at your past show you?
major_20.shortUpright: A moment to look back honestly, forgive what you can and answer what is calling you forward.

major_21.name: The World
major_21.shortReversed: Something may be nearly finished. What final step or loose end deserves your attention?
major_21.shortUpright: A cycle may be coming full circle. This card invites you to pause and honor what you have completed.

pentacles_01.name: Ace of Pentacles
pentacles_01.shortReversed: A promising start may need firmer ground. You might check what support it needs before you build on it.
pentacles_01.shortUpright: A small, solid beginning asks for your attention. Something practical may be ready to be planted and looked after.

pentacles_02.name: Two of Pentacles
pentacles_02.shortReversed: The balancing act may have tipped into strain. Consider which demand could be set down, shared or moved for now.
pentacles_02.shortUpright: You may be keeping several things in motion at once. Notice the rhythm that lets you adjust without losing your footing.

pentacles_03.name: Three of Pentacles
pentacles_03.shortReversed: A shared effort may be pulling in different directions. It could help to revisit roles, plans and how you listen to each other.
pentacles_03.shortUpright: Good work often grows between people. Notice how different skills could fit together on something you care about.

pentacles_04.name: Four of Pentacles
pentacles_04.shortReversed: A tight grip may be easing, or asking to. You might explore what you could let flow without feeling unsafe.
pentacles_04.shortUpright: You may be holding something close to keep it safe. Notice where that protection steadies you and where it starts to restrict you.

pentacles_05.name: Five of Pentacles
pentacles_05.shortReversed: A difficult stretch may be easing. You might notice where warmth and support are starting to reach you again.
pentacles_05.shortUpright: A season may feel cold or lacking. Help can sometimes be closer than it seems, even when asking feels hard.

pentacles_06.name: Six of Pentacles
pentacles_06.shortReversed: An exchange may feel lopsided. You might look at what is given, what is expected in return and what would feel more even.
pentacles_06.shortUpright: Resources, time and care are moving between people. Notice how you give, how you receive and what feels fair to everyone.

pentacles_07.name: Seven of Pentacles
pentacles_07.shortReversed: Progress may feel slower than you hoped. You might ask whether the effort needs patience, a new direction or simply a rest.
pentacles_07.shortUpright: Something you have tended is growing slowly. It may be a good moment to pause, look at your progress and choose what to nurture next.

pentacles_08.name: Eight of Pentacles
pentacles_08.shortReversed: Work may have become either rushed or endlessly polished. You might look for the care that first drew you to it.
pentacles_08.shortUpright: Steady, focused practice is shaping a skill. Notice the quiet satisfaction of doing one thing well, again and again.

pentacles_09.name: Nine of Pentacles
pentacles_09.shortReversed: Comfort may feel out of reach or strangely empty. You might ask what would let you truly rest in what you already have.
pentacles_09.shortUpright: You may be ready to enjoy what your own effort has cultivated. Notice the quiet confidence of standing in a space you shaped.

pentacles_10.name: Ten of Pentacles
pentacles_10.shortReversed: Old structures or expectations may feel heavy. You might consider which traditions to keep and which to reshape for yourself.
pentacles_10.shortUpright: Something built to last may be coming into view. Notice the roots, traditions and people that make you feel part of something larger.

pentacles_11.name: Page of Pentacles
pentacles_11.shortReversed: Interest may be there without follow-through. Consider what small, realistic step would turn curiosity into practice.
pentacles_11.shortUpright: A curious, studious energy is present. You might notice something practical you would like to learn, and take a first real step toward it.

pentacles_12.name: Knight of Pentacles
pentacles_12.shortReversed: Consistency may have turned into a rut. You might consider where a small change of pace could bring energy back.
pentacles_12.shortUpright: Steady, reliable effort is moving things forward. Notice the value of showing up consistently, even when progress feels slow.

pentacles_13.name: Queen of Pentacles
pentacles_13.shortReversed: Care may be flowing outward while you run low. You might look at how to tend your own needs as warmly as others'.
pentacles_13.shortUpright: Practical warmth and care are available to you. Notice how you create comfort for others, and whether you include yourself.

pentacles_14.name: King of Pentacles
pentacles_14.shortReversed: Security may have become a heavy weight to carry. You might ask what success means to you beyond control or appearances.
pentacles_14.shortUpright: A steady, capable presence is available to you. Notice how you could use your experience and resources to create stability for yourself and others.

swords_01.name: Ace of Swords
swords_01.shortReversed: Clarity may be close but not quite in reach yet; there is room to let the fog settle before deciding.
swords_01.shortUpright: A clear thought arrives; you might notice what becomes simple once you name it plainly.

swords_02.name: Two of Swords
swords_02.shortReversed: The pause may be ending; something you avoided looking at could be asking for a gentle, honest glance.
swords_02.shortUpright: Two options balance each other for now; you might notice what you are keeping out of view to hold the peace.

swords_03.name: Three of Swords
swords_03.shortReversed: The sharpest part of a hurt may be easing; you might notice what helps you breathe a little more freely.
swords_03.shortUpright: A sad or hurtful moment may be asking to be felt rather than explained away; sorrow can be honored gently.

swords_04.name: Four of Swords
swords_04.shortReversed: Rest may keep getting postponed, or a quiet stretch may be ready to end; you might notice which feels true.
swords_04.shortUpright: A pause is part of the work; this may be a time to lay things down and let your mind grow quiet.

swords_05.name: Five of Swords
swords_05.shortReversed: A conflict may be ready to cool; there could be room to let go of being right in favor of peace.
swords_05.shortUpright: An argument may be won while something else is lost; you might ask what the victory actually cost.

swords_06.name: Six of Swords
swords_06.shortReversed: Something may be holding you on the old shore; you might notice what you are not yet ready to leave.
swords_06.shortUpright: You may be moving from rough water toward calmer shores; change can be quiet and slow and still be real.

swords_07.name: Seven of Swords
swords_07.shortReversed: A hidden plan may be losing its appeal; honesty with yourself or others could feel lighter than the effort of hiding.
swords_07.shortUpright: A clever plan or quiet workaround may be in play; you might ask whether it fits the person you want to be.

swords_08.name: Eight of Swords
swords_08.shortReversed: The ties may be loosening; you might notice a belief that no longer holds you as tightly as it did.
swords_08.shortUpright: You may feel hemmed in, yet some limits live mostly in thought; one small movement might show more room than it seems.

swords_09.name: Nine of Swords
swords_09.shortReversed: The weight of worry may be starting to lift, or it may be asking to be shared rather than carried alone.
swords_09.shortUpright: Worries can loom larger in the quiet hours; you might notice which fears are about now and which are about maybe.

swords_10.name: Ten of Swords
swords_10.shortReversed: The lowest point may be behind you; you might notice the first signs of steadiness returning.
swords_10.shortUpright: A hard chapter may be reaching its end; naming it can make room for rest and a slow turn.

swords_11.name: Page of Swords
swords_11.shortReversed: Eager thoughts may be scattering in many directions; you could notice where listening would serve better than speaking.
swords_11.shortUpright: Curiosity is awake; you might follow a question with fresh eyes and see where it takes your thinking.

swords_12.name: Knight of Swords
swords_12.shortReversed: Speed may be outrunning thought; slowing down briefly could help you arrive where you actually mean to go.
swords_12.shortUpright: Momentum is here; you might channel quick thinking into purposeful action while keeping an eye on who is beside you.

swords_13.name: Queen of Swords
swords_13.shortReversed: Clarity may have hardened into distance; you might notice where warmth could return without losing honesty.
swords_13.shortUpright: Clear sight and a kind, direct voice can go together; you might trust what experience has taught you.

swords_14.name: King of Swords
swords_14.shortReversed: Logic may have become rigid or detached; you might ask whether your principles still leave room for people.
swords_14.shortUpright: Steady reasoning and fair principles can guide you; you might decide from what is true rather than what is easy.

wands_01.name: Ace of Wands
wands_01.shortReversed: The spark may be there, but something keeps it from catching yet; notice what it needs.
wands_01.shortUpright: A new spark of interest is asking for a little air and attention before it can become a flame.

wands_02.name: Two of Wands
wands_02.shortReversed: Comfort and caution may be keeping a bigger plan on the shelf; you could look again at what holds you there.
wands_02.shortUpright: You stand at the edge of what you know, looking outward; this is a good moment to sketch where you might want to go.

wands_03.name: Three of Wands
wands_03.shortReversed: Progress may feel slower than you hoped; this could be a time to adjust expectations rather than give up.
wands_03.shortUpright: Something you set in motion is starting to travel; you can watch for what comes back and prepare for the next stage.

wands_04.name: Four of Wands
wands_04.shortReversed: A celebration may feel quieter or less settled than expected; you might look at what would help you feel at home.
wands_04.shortUpright: A milestone deserves to be marked; this is a moment to gather, give thanks and enjoy a sense of home.

wands_05.name: Five of Wands
wands_05.shortReversed: A clash may be quieting down, or going underground; you might notice which disagreements still need a fair hearing.
wands_05.shortUpright: Many voices and energies are clashing; the friction may be sharpening ideas as much as it is wearing you out.

wands_06.name: Six of Wands
wands_06.shortReversed: Recognition may feel missing or less satisfying than hoped; you might ask what success means to you on your own terms.
wands_06.shortUpright: Your effort may be getting noticed; let yourself receive some recognition and notice who helped you get here.

wands_07.name: Seven of Wands
wands_07.shortReversed: Defending everything at once can wear you out; you might choose which ground is truly worth holding.
wands_07.shortUpright: You may be holding a position that matters to you; this card honors the courage it takes to stand firm.

wands_08.name: Eight of Wands
wands_08.shortReversed: Pace and timing may feel off, with delays or too much haste; you might pause to check where your energy is aimed.
wands_08.shortUpright: Things may be moving quickly now; energy that was stuck finds a clear direction, and you can ride the momentum with care.

wands_09.name: Nine of Wands
wands_09.shortReversed: Staying on guard for so long can be tiring; you might notice where it is safe to rest and let others in.
wands_09.shortUpright: You have come through a lot and are still standing; this card honors your resilience on the final stretch.

wands_10.name: Ten of Wands
wands_10.shortReversed: Some of the load may be ready to come off your shoulders; you could look at what you can put down, share or refuse.
wands_10.shortUpright: You may be carrying more than your share; this card invites you to notice the weight and what truly needs carrying.

wands_11.name: Page of Wands
wands_11.shortReversed: Enthusiasm may be flickering between many things or held back by doubt; you might choose one to explore gently.
wands_11.shortUpright: A curious, playful energy wants to explore; follow what excites you and let yourself be a beginner.

wands_12.name: Knight of Wands
wands_12.shortReversed: Energy may be running ahead of direction; this could be a moment to slow the charge and choose where to aim.
wands_12.shortUpright: A bold, adventurous energy is ready to move; you might follow your passion while keeping an eye on the road.

wands_13.name: Queen of Wands
wands_13.shortReversed: Your inner fire may be flickering or stretched thin; you could look at what drains your confidence and what renews it.
wands_13.shortUpright: A warm, confident energy is available to you; you might let yourself take up space and share your light with others.

wands_14.name: King of Wands
wands_14.shortReversed: Strong drive may be tipping into impatience or control; you might check whether your vision still leaves room for others.
wands_14.shortUpright: A clear, visionary energy invites you to lead with purpose and turn big ideas into a direction others can follow.
